note: The files core/widgets/error_feedback.dart, route_error_page.dart, safe_router_config.dart and v2_gate.dart do not exist in 70a94933 (4.1.3); they were added on this branch. verdicts.proof: Latch confirmed at features/loyalty/loyalty_levelup_overlay.dart:131-138 (_showing, loyaltyPollPaused) with release in finally :214-219; it also holds back while paymentScreenActiveProvider or onboarding is active (:126-128). showErrorDialog (core/widgets/error_feedback.dart:132-162) uses the same showDialog route in both looks (dismissed by tapping outside, returns null). Confirmed: 70a94933 main.dart:403 mounts HandoverPromptWatcher, and 70a94933 router.dart:112, :171 and :254-257 define the /protocol route behind login. Commit 3e872afe ('protokol jen na displeji', kiosk 1.2.11) deleted handover_prompt_watcher.dart and protocol_screen.dart and is in HEAD. The current lib has no Handover watcher and no /protocol route (grep). The removal applies to BOTH looks, so v2 does not differ from the old look. Compared with 4.1.3, however, the app no longer offers the protocol. The rule is enforced by the kiosk unit, not by the database: raspberry/motogo-box/motogo_box/controller_codes.py returns error 'protocol_required' (CONTRACT.md:661), and grep finds no protocol_required in supabase/migrations.

main.dart:93-156 ErrorWidget.builder. When MgV2.applied is true it builds CrashViewV2 (:103-116) with the same goBack (rootNavigator maybePop) and goHome (go('/')) as the old widget (:137-148). The full page offers primary Domů and secondary Zpět, and the close button goes Home. The compact card offers both actions as text buttons (features/*/v2 crash_view: _CompactCrash). Caveat: the try/catch at :104-115 catches only errors from the constructor. If CrashViewV2 fails while it is being built (later, in its build method), the old widget is NOT used as a fallback, contrary to the comment. The consequence could not be determined without running the app.
verdicts.fix_idea: If wanted, wrap CrashViewV2's build body in its own try/catch that returns the old Material crash column, so the fallback the comment promises really exists.

verdicts.proof: core/v2/flag/v2_gate.dart is a single gate for both looks (main.dart:496). _location returns null when a go_router page is pushed (:70-91). applyPendingIfSafe in core/feature_flags.dart:155-166 refuses a switch while a payment is running, on a path outside kV2TabRoots (v2_scope.dart:50) or on a URL with a query. Limitation, the same in both looks: the gate sees only go_router pages. Dialogs, bottom sheets and the MgProgress DialogRoute opened by Navigator over a tab root are not detected. On resume (:118-122) a pending flag can therefore switch the look while, for example, a dialog or sheet opened from Domů, Motorky, Rezervace or Profil is still open. V2Switch at router.dart:381-389 then swaps the page widget under that dialog or sheet (its State is disposed). This is not a v2-only weakness, so the verdict is HOLDS, but the claim 'never in the middle' is not fully true.
verdicts.fix_idea: In _MgV2Gate._location also return null when the root navigator has a popup route above the page, for example rootNavigatorKey.currentState?.canPop() == true, or when a NavigatorObserver counts open PopupRoute/DialogRoute instances. That defers the switch until the dialog or sheet is closed.
